seo.title: Grand Dine Restaurant Deira | مطعم جراند داين | Turkish, Afghani, Arabic & Indian, Al Muteena
seo.description: Grand Dine Restaurant, Al Muteena Street, Deira: Turkish, Afghani, Indian, Arabic and steak in a spacious, family-friendly dining hall with live grill, chicken madbi, mutton haneeth and mixed grills. Open till 2 AM on weekends. 4.6 from 592 reviews.

hero.lede: Turkish, Afghani, Indian and Arabic cooking in a spacious green-and-gold dining hall: live grill, chicken madbi, mutton haneeth, mixed grills and biryani, open until 2 AM on weekends.
